'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2020–21 United States election protests]]
**[[January 6 United States Capitol attack|2021 storming of the United States Capitol]]
***A [[United States Capitol Police]] officer injured in yesterday's [[riot]] in [[Washington, D.C.]], is revealed to be on life support as a result of the events. After being erroneously reported as having died earlier, he was finally reported as deceased by the Capitol Police, who name him as [[Death of Brian Sicknick|Brian D. Sicknick]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/01/07/politics/capitol-police-officer-riot/index.html (CNN)] [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/capitol-police-officer-dies-injuries-suffered-riots/story?id=75124131&cid=social_twitter_abcn (ABC News)]
***[[Michael C. Stenger]] and [[Paul D. Irving]], the respective Sergeants at Arms of the [[Sergeant at Arms of the United States Senate|Senate]] and [[Sergeant at Arms of the United States House of Representatives|House of Representatives]], resign upon the requests of [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]] [[Nancy Pelosi]] and [[Senate Majority Leader]] [[Mitch McConnell]]. [https://thehill.com/homenews/senate/533279-mcconnell-ousts-senate-sergeant-at-arms-after-capitol-riots (''The Hill'')] [https://www.rollcall.com/2021/01/07/mob-fallout-pelosi-calls-for-capitol-police-chief-to-be-fired-house-saa-to-resign/ (Roll Call)]
***[[United States Capitol Police]] chief [[Steven Sund]] announces that he will resign following the storming of the [[United States Capitol]] by pro-Trump supporters. [https://www.huffpost.com/entry/capitol-police-chief-steven-sund-resigns_n_5ff760cec5b6c0ae2e737470 (''HuffPost'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Boeing 737 MAX groundings]]
**[[Boeing]] agrees to pay [[US$]]2.5 billion to settle criminal charges claiming that it covered-up design flaws in its [[Boeing 737 MAX]] passenger planes from safety officials. The [[United States Department of Justice|U.S. Department of Justice]] says that the firm chose "profit over candour". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-55582496 (BBC News)]
*[[Elon Musk]] overtakes [[Jeff Bezos]] by just over US$4 billion to become the richest person in the world. [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/01/07/investing/elon-musk-jeff-bezos-richest-person/index.html (CNN)]
*The [[Cryptocurrency|cryptocurrencies]] market capitalization reaches US$1 trillion for the first time. [https://www.marketwatch.com/story/cryptocurrency-market-cap-tops-1-trillion-with-bitcoin-above-37000-2021-01-07 (Marketwatch)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports a record of 3,519 new cases and 89 deaths in the past 24 hours. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/covid-19-ontario-january-7-2021-record-cases-deaths-1.5864479 (CBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
****[[Mexico]] reports a record 13,734 new cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of cases to  1,493,569. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-mexico/mexico-reports-13734-new-coronavirus-cases-1044-more-deaths-idINS0N2EF01W (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Connecticut]], [[Lineage B.1.1.7|Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Connecticut]] reports its first case of a new variant of [[SARS-CoV-2]] in two people, aged 15 and 25, who live in [[New Haven County, Connecticut|New Haven County]]. One had traveled to [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] and the other to [[New York (state)|New York]]. [https://www.nbcconnecticut.com/news/coronavirus/two-cases-of-covid-19-variant-found-in-u-k-now-confirmed-in-connecticut/2398772/ (WVIT-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)|COVID-19 pandemic in New York]]
*****[[New York (state)|New York]] reports a record 17,636 new cases in the past 24 hours, according to [[Governor of New York|Governor]] [[Andrew Cuomo]]. It also reports 197 new deaths, which is the highest single-day total since the second week of May. [https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/coronavirus/cuomo-denies-nypd-eligible-for-vaccine-as-feud-with-mayor-continues/2817034/ (WNBC-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pennsylvania]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
*****[[Pennsylvania]] reports its first case of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in a resident of [[Dauphin County, Pennsylvania|Dauphin County]] who traveled internationally. [https://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/coronavirus/first-case-of-u-k-coronavirus-variant-discovered-in-pennsylvania/2659085/ (WCAU-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Texas]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
*****[[Texas]] health officials report the state's first case of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in a resident of [[Harris County, Texas|Harris County]] with no travel history. [https://dfw.cbslocal.com/2021/01/07/health-officials-confirm-first-known-case-of-uk-covid-19-variant-in-texas/ (KTVT-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Illinois]]
*****[[Illinois]] surpasses 1 million cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], becoming the fifth state to do so after [[California]], [[Texas]], [[Florida]], and New York. [https://chicago.suntimes.com/coronavirus/2021/1/7/22218952/illinois-coronavirus-million-cases-deaths-vaccine-pritzker-covid-19-jan-7 (''Chicago Sun-Times'')]
****The [[United States]] reports a world record of more than 4,000 deaths for the first time. [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2021/01/07/health/us-coronavirus-thursday/index.html (CNN)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in China]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
*****[[China]] reports 52 locally transmitted cases in the past 24 hours, the highest single-day total since July, as [[Hebei]], which enters "wartime mode", reports 51 of the cases. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/1/7/covid-cases-in-hebei-nearly-double-as-china-province-sealed-off (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a new record for the second consecutive day of 9,321 new cases, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 797,723. [https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5324704/dki-di-atas-2-ribu-ini-sebaran-9321-kasus-harian-covid-19-ri-7-januari (detikHealth)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Prime Minister of Japan|Prime Minister]] [[Yoshihide Suga]] declares a [[state of emergency]] for the [[Greater Tokyo Area]], which includes the capital [[Tokyo]] and neighbouring prefectures such as [[Chiba Prefecture|Chiba]], [[Kanagawa Prefecture|Kanagawa]] and [[Saitama Prefecture|Saitama]], from tomorrow until February 7. The [[Government of Japan|government]] asks restaurants in those areas to close at 8 p.m. daily and also urges residents to limit non-essential travel. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/japan-tokyo-state-of-emergency-declaration-covid-19-cases-rise-13911102 (CNA)]
****Nationwide, [[Japan]] reports a record 7,568 new cases in the past 24 hours. Tokyo reports a record 2,447 new cases, bringing the total number of cases in the prefecture to 68,790. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2021/01/07/national/tokyo-2000-coronavirus-cases/ (''The Japan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a new record for the second consecutive day of 3,027 new cases. It is the first time that the country has reported more than 3,000 cases and brings the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 128,465. [https://www.theedgemarkets.com/article/covid19-malaysia-sees-record-high-3027-new-cases-including-1103-johor-eight-more-deaths (The Edge Markets MY)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****The [[Czech Republic]] reports a record of 17,668 new cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of cases to 794,740. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/czechia-reports-record-number-of-daily-covid-19-cases/2102086 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] surpasses 60,000 deaths from [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/01/07/russia-passes-60k-coronavirus-deaths-a72550 (''The Moscow Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****Spain surpasses two million cases of COVID-19. [https://cadenaser.com/ser/2021/01/07/sociedad/1610034702_021858.html (Cadena SER)]
****[[Catalonia]] reports their first case of a [[Lineage B.1.1.7|new variant]] of [[SARS-CoV-2]] from a British resident who travelled to that region. [https://www.rtve.es/television/20210107/primer-cas-soca-britanica-catalunya/2063000.shtml (RTVE)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports 1,162 new deaths in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total since April 21, bringing the nationwide death toll to 78,508. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/covid-uk-deaths-today-latest-update-b1784010.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Palau]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Palau]] begins its vaccination program, with outgoing [[President of Palau|President]] [[Thomas Remengesau Jr.]] and incoming President [[Surangel Whipps Jr.]] receiving the first two doses. The country plans to vaccinate more than 18,000 people with the [[Moderna]] vaccine provided by the United States. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/434106/covid-19-vaccination-programme-underway-in-palau (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] surpasses 200,000 deaths of COVID-19, becoming the second country to do so after the [[United States]], as a record 87,843 cases are reported in the past 24 hours. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20210108-brazil-s-covid-19-death-toll-surpasses-200-000-as-cases-once-again-spike (France 24)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-01-07/brazil-covid-deaths-pass-200-000-with-vaccinations-still-on-hold (Bloomberg)]
*The [[World Organisation for Animal Health]] confirms that [[Senegal]] has reported an outbreak of the highly pathogenic [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N1|H5N1]] [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N1|bird flu]] at a [[poultry farming|poultry farm]] in [[Thiès]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/healthNews/idUSKBN29C2H4?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iraq–United States relations]], [[Assassination of Qasem Soleimani]]
**[[Iraq]] issues an [[arrest warrant]] for [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]], accusing him of "premediated murder" due to his role in the killings of [[Qasem Soleimani]] and [[Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis]]. [https://www.usnews.com/news/us/articles/2021-01-07/iraq-court-issues-arrest-warrant-against-trump-for-murder (U.S. News)]
*Australia's financial watchdog is reviewing calculations for transfers worth US$1.8 billion sent to the country from the Vatican since 2014, after the [[Vatican City|Vatican]] and the [[Catholic Church in Australia|Australian Church]] call for clarification. The transfers ranged from yearly totals of [[Australian dollar|A$]]71.6 million (US$55.2 million) in 2014 to A$581.3 million in 2017, with about 47,000 separate transfers. "That amount of money and that number of transfers did not leave the Vatican City", a senior Vatican official with knowledge of the city-state's finances told Reuters last week. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-01-07/australia-reviewing-funds-transfers-after-vatican-seeks-clarification (Reuters)]
 
'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2020 United States elections]]
**[[2020 United States Senate elections]]
***[[2020–21 United States Senate election in Georgia]], [[2020–21 United States Senate special election in Georgia]]
****Incumbent Republican Senator [[Kelly Loeffler]] concedes to her Democratic challenger [[Raphael Warnock]]. Former Republican Senator [[David Perdue]] has yet to concede to Democratic challenger [[Jon Ossoff]], even as Ossoff expands his lead beyond the margin necessary to demand a state-funded recount. [https://www.ajc.com/politics/politics-blog/republican-kelly-loeffler-concedes-defeat-to-raphael-warnock/F7MP7XRHRVFULEV5F7TR5FXF5U/ (''Atlanta Journal-Constitution'')] 
**[[2020 United States presidential election]]
***[[2021 United States Electoral College vote count]]
****[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Rep.]] [[Scott Perry]] and [[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[Josh Hawley]] of [[Missouri]] object to [[Pennsylvania]]'s electoral college votes, forcing a second vote to accept or reject the objection. This comes after the House and the Senate defeated a similar objection to [[Arizona]]'s electoral college votes from Rep. [[Paul Gosar]] and Senator [[Ted Cruz]]. The Senate and the House both vote to reject the objection, allowing [[Joe Biden]] and [[Kamala Harris]] to receive the state’s electoral votes. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2021/jan/06/georgia-election-latest-news-senate-ossoff-warnock-democrats-republicans-trump-biden?page=with:block-5ff69a208f081f3586ba65cb (''The Guardian'')]
****The [[United States Congress]] certifies [[2020 United States presidential election|the election]] of [[Joe Biden]] as [[President-elect of the United States]] and [[Kamala Harris]] as [[Vice President–elect of the United States|Vice President]]. Biden and Harris received 306 electoral votes while [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Mike Pence]] received 232. The winners will be [[Inauguration of Joe Biden|inaugurated]] on January 20. [https://www.npr.org/2021/01/07/954234902/congress-certifies-biden-victory-after-pro-trump-rioters-storm-the-capitol (NPR)]
****Rep. [[Jake LaTurner]] ([[Kansas|KS]]-[[Kansas's 2nd congressional district|2]]) is notified of his positive COVID-19 diagnosis after the vote on Arizona and goes into isolation, missing the Pennsylvania vote. [https://www.kansascity.com/news/politics-government/article248335175.html (''Kansas City Star'')]
***[[Presidential transition of Joe Biden]]
****Donald Trump, still disagreeing with the election results that resulted in a victory for [[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Joe Biden]], said through spokesperson [[Dan Scavino]], "Even though I totally disagree with the outcome of the election, and the facts bear me out, nevertheless there will be an orderly transition on January 20th." [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-election-trump-statement-idUSKBN29C131 (Reuters)]
****[[White House Deputy Chief of Staff]] [[Chris Liddell]] orders the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] staff to submit resignation letters by January 20 as a step to clear the way for Biden to fill the government with his [[Cabinet of Joe Biden|own staff]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2021/01/07/trump-white-house-political-staff-455947 (''Politico'')]
****President Trump condemns the [[2021 United States Capitol attack|attack]] on the [[United States Capitol]] and [[Concession (politics)|concedes]] the race for the first time. He also says that his focus is to ensure a smooth transition of power to the [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/full-text-speech-which-donald-trump-finally-concedes-election-biden-1559880 (''Newsweek'')] [https://www.denverpost.com/2021/01/07/trump-condemns-capitol-riot-concedes-biden/ (''The Denver Post'')] [https://www.forbes.com/sites/rachelsandler/2021/01/07/trump-concedes-election-defeat-commits-to-peaceful-transition-of-power/?sh=7e8286d13212 (''Forbes'')]
***[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack|Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol]]
****[[Elaine Chao]] and [[Betsy DeVos]] submit their resignations as Secretaries of [[United States Secretary of Transportation|Transportation]] and [[United States Secretary of Education|Education]], respectively, in response to the storming of the [[United States Capitol]] by pro-Trump protesters. [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/01/07/politics/elaine-chao-cabinet-resignation-trump/index.html (CNN)] [https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/533281-betsy-devos-resigns-as-education-secretary (''The Hill'')]
****[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Rep.]] [[Adam Kinzinger]] ([[Illinois|IL]]-[[Illinois's 16th congressional district|16]]) calls for Trump to be removed via the [[Twenty-fifth Amendment to the United States Constitution|25th amendment]] following the Capitol riot, making him the first [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] to do so. [https://www.newsweek.com/rep-adam-kinzinger-becomes-first-republican-call-trumps-removal-office-25th-amendment-1559747 (''Newsweek'')]
*[[2020 Ghanaian general election]]
**[[Nana Akufo-Addo]] is sworn in as [[President of Ghana]] for a second term. [https://www.bbc.com/news/amp/world-africa-55575420 (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Donald Trump on social media]]
**[[Facebook]] announces that it has extended the lock of Donald Trump's official account for at least the remainder of his term due to the heightened risk of [[political violence]]. [[Snapchat]] also bans Trump from posting on the app until further notice. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-01-07/facebook-instagram-restrictions-on-trump-accounts-extended (Bloomberg)]
*[[Twitter suspensions]]
**[[Twitter]] announces that it has permanently suspended American [[Lawyer|attorney]] and [[Conspiracy theory|conspiracy theorist]] [[L. Lin Wood]] for violating their rules. [https://thehill.com/policy/technology/533132-twitter-permanently-removes-pro-trump-lawyer-lin-wood-from-platform (''The Hill'')]
